title: Earthworks Lot Record

items.text: Have all in ground services been located?
Have dated photos been taken of the area and its surrounds before any work started?
Are sediment controls and tree protection (by others) in place?
Has the work area been set out from CDI's survey control?
Have all vegetation, roots, rubbish and organic material been removed from the area?
Has the topsoil been stripped and stockpiled separately for landscaping use only?
Is the stripped surface free of soft spots, old fill and debris?
If any unexpected material was found (unknown fill, contamination, suspected asbestos or rock), was work stopped and CDI notified?
Has the existing subgrade been compacted and tested? Nuke test Result ____ % (95% MMDD) or  CBR Result: ______ % (5%)
Where the CBR is below 5%, has at least 500 mm of approved fill been placed?  Depth placed: ______ mm
Has the fill source been approved, with test certificates received?
Is the imported fill clean sand or cracker dust, free of clay, rubbish and stones over 75 mm?
Were service trenches inspected, and as-constructed details received, before filling over them?
Is the finished platform at design level and graded to drain, with no ponding?  Survey ref: ______
items.notice: HP1 — HOLD POINT: Has the subgrade been proof rolled with no deflection, heave or rutting, and has the geotech confirmed CBR of at least 5% after filling?

items.text: Have the footings and pits been excavated to the correct line, level and size?
Has any over-excavation been recorded and made good?
For excavations deeper than 1.5 m: are the sides battered, benched or shored, with edge protection and ladder access, and is the daily inspection signed?
Are spoil and plant kept at least 1 m back from the excavation edge?
Is the base clean, dry and free of loose material?
Has the base under the footings been compacted and nuke tested to 95% modified?  Result: ______ %
items.notice: HP2 — HOLD POINT: Has the founding been approved? | HP3 — HANDED OVER TO CONCRETE: Is the area ready to hand over to concrete works?
